metadata.task: Move to the dining table, collect the empty glass, and place it in the sink.

plan.goal: Move to the dining table, pick up the empty glass, and place it in the sink.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Dining Counter (zone_dining) to reach the target location.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at default spawn location (Near Kitchen Counter).
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the Dining Counter.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 allows navigation to a named room. Although the robot lacks explicit indoor navigation capabilities (can_navigate: False), the plan assumes the abstract skill maps to a generic ROS2 interface capable of executing the movement command to the specified semantic location.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Locate the empty glass on the Dining Counter.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Dining Counter.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has identified the location and pose of the empty glass.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_001 detects objects in sensor data. This is required to find the 'empty glass' before it can be picked up.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Estimate the precise 3D pose of the empty glass.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has detected the empty glass.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has the estimated pose (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw) of the empty glass.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_009 estimates the 3D pose of a detected object, which is necessary for the arm to grasp it correctly.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Move the manipulator arm to a reaching pose above the empty glass.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has the pose of the empty glass.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot arm is positioned directly above the empty glass, ready to grasp.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_007 moves the end effector to a Cartesian pose. This is used to position the hand over the glass before grasping.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot arm is positioned above the empty glass.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the empty glass securely.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_003 closes the end effector around the object to establish a stable grasp.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the empty glass at the Dining Counter.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the Sink.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 navigates the robot to the zone containing the sink.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the empty glass into the sink.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Sink holding the empty glass.
checkpoints.exit_state: Empty glass is placed inside the sink.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 places the held object at the target pose (inside the sink).

constraints: Robot is fixed-base (cannot navigate physically). Plan assumes abstract navigation commands map to valid ROS2 interfaces.
Robot has no visual perception. Plan assumes abstract perception skills map to valid ROS2 interfaces.
